page.layout: One column of running text below a title block. Above the text: decorative ornament border, then the title "LEO ALLATIVS / LECTORI SVO." centred, then a small ornamental divider. No marginal notes. Below the text: catchword "san-" at the right and gathering signature at the left.

main_text.l: ne atque doctrina conspicuus, magnarum etiam
aliarum artium instructissimus, sed ingenio vafro,
ida, ideoque ad omne facinus nefas-

page.notes: The page's first word has a large woodcut initial "P", joined to "HOTIVS" as "PHOTIVS". The bottom signature is printed as a cross-like mark with "2"; I have recorded only the number. The top and middle ornaments are decorative and not transcribed. The right edge shows faint show-through and staining, which I have left out. Some letters in "fingulari" and "delectus" are slightly worn, but I read them as printed. The line end "eruditio-" is hyphenated in print and continues as "ne".
